description: This file defines the AssetUtils utility class, which provides static methods for loading assets (binary data, JSON objects, and bitmaps) from the application's assets folder in an Android project.

classes.name: AssetUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for loading assets such as raw bytes, JSON objects, and bitmaps from the application's assets folder.

methods.name: loadAsset
methods.description: Loads asset data as a byte array from the assets folder given the asset filename.

methods.name: loadJSONAsset
methods.description: Loads a JSON object from the specified asset file.

methods.name: loadBitmapAsset
methods.description: Loads a Bitmap object from the specified asset file.
